text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion isn't feeling well, so I take her to the infirmary to get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Nnngh, sorry. I'm just going to have a little nap…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …? What is this place?

text_block_list.name: Demon King
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh-heh… So you've awoken, Princess… It is I, the Demon King…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The Demon King? I see. And what can I do for you?

text_block_list.name: Demon King
text_block_list.text: You are here as my hostage, to ensure that the Umamusume-Trainer Alliance doesn't try anything foolish. Now, sit tight in your front row seat and watch as the world is annihilated!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: If you truly are "king," then I ask that you take a good look around you.

text_block_list.name: Demon Child
text_block_list.text: Mommy, the crops aren't growing at all. What's wrong with them?

text_block_list.name: Demon Mother
text_block_list.text: It's because this land is barren… Nothing will ever grow here.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You wage war with other nations while you leave the people of your own kingdom to suffer. And what's more, you speak of annihilation and the like…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: How could you turn a blind eye to the struggles of your nation's people?!

text_block_list.name: Demon King
text_block_list.text: Ngh, grk?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: However… If you are willing to change your ways, I shall share with you a few pieces of knowledge I've picked up.

text_block_list.name: Demon King
text_block_list.text: Knowledge? Wh-what kind of knowledge?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I speak of the rice-cultivating methods of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Demon King
text_block_list.text: Oh… Ohhh?! Look at all that green… It's dazzling!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: After you've cooked the rice, you can fry it if you like. Or boil it. It's a different kind of dish altogether, but mochi is delicious as well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: If you take care of the crops until autumn, you'll end up with a field of priceless golden treasure!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: …I'm suddenly feeling quite peckish. Off to have a proper meal! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After getting some good rest, Fine Motion is back to her usual self!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'll teach you all about Japanese ramen!

text_block_list.name: Demon King
text_block_list.text: Ra…men?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, you've never heard of it? Allow me to tell you all about it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The main ingredient of ramen noodles is wheat flour, but then something called lye water is mixed into it, and then…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Whoops, I droned on for a bit there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After speaking for so long and with such passion in her dream, Fine Motion wakes up feeling as if she barely got any rest.
